verdict.rationale: Claude Code offers CLAUDE.md as a shared, session-loaded file for coding standards and architecture decisions, and MCP integrations that let it pull docs from Google Drive, Jira, and Slack, giving some cross-source context. However, there is no dedicated 'workspace' feature that indexes/aggregates docs and repos into a persistent, browsable shared knowledge base for the whole team to reference outside of active coding sessions. Missing for 10: a unified workspace/knowledge-hub UI, cross-repo/doc search or indexing, and team-wide visibility into the aggregated source of truth beyond per-session CLAUDE.md and ad-hoc MCP calls.
